name: @aluvia/mcp

tools.name: session_start
tools.description: Start a browser session with Aluvia smart proxy. Spawns a headless browser connected through Aluvia gateway. Returns session details including CDP URL for remote debugging.

url.description: URL to open in the browser

connectionId.description: Use a specific Aluvia connection ID

headful.description: Run browser in headful mode (default: headless)

autoUnblock.description: Auto-detect blocks and reload through Aluvia proxy

tools.name: session_close
tools.description: Close one or all running browser sessions. Sends SIGTERM for graceful shutdown, then SIGKILL if needed.

browserSession.description: Name of session to close (auto-selects if only one)

tools.name: session_list
tools.description: List all active browser sessions with their PIDs, URLs, and proxy configuration.

tools.name: session_get
tools.description: Get detailed information about a running session including proxy URLs, connection data, and block detection state.

browserSession.description: Name of session (auto-selects if only one)

tools.name: session_rotate_ip
tools.description: Rotate the IP address for a running session by generating a new session ID on the Aluvia connection.

browserSession.description: Name of session (auto-selects if only one)

tools.name: session_set_geo
tools.description: Set or clear the target geographic region for a running session. Affects which mobile IP pool is used.

clear.description: Clear the target geo instead of setting one

browserSession.description: Name of session (auto-selects if only one)

tools.name: session_set_rules
tools.description: Append or remove proxy routing rules for a running session. Rules are hostname patterns (e.g. "example.com", "*.google.com").

remove.description: Comma-separated rules to remove instead of appending

browserSession.description: Name of session (auto-selects if only one)

tools.name: account_get
tools.description: Get Aluvia account information including plan details and current balance.

tools.name: account_usage
tools.description: Get Aluvia account usage statistics for a date range.

tools.name: geos_list
tools.description: List all available geographic regions for proxy targeting.
